user.summary: Roguelikes, 200-hour RPGs and the occasional cozy farm. Controller > keyboard — fight me. Always down for Deep Rock on Fridays.

featured.name: Tales of Eternia Remastered
featured.shortDescription: Tales of Eternia returns as a remastered edition! As the threat of world destruction looms, an epic journey begins to determine the fate of two worlds: Inferia and Celestia.

featured.name: Scam With Your Friends
featured.shortDescription: Run a scam call center with your friends. Use increasingly ridiculous schemes to trick AI callers out of their life savings. Hit your daily quota, cause chaos around the office, and survive a brutal performance review from your rageaholic boss.

featured.name: Folded Fables: Tidy Up The Dragon Hoard
featured.shortDescription: Unwind in a relaxing first-person Tidy Up game where you'll sort and arrange 5,648 treasures in a papercraft world. Level up, unlock new skills, and tally every coin. Play solo or tidy up together with friends. Supports up to 16 players in online co-op.

featured.name: Chained Beasts
featured.shortDescription: Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelike. Fight chaotic battles chained to your friends. Use your chains or the arena to beat up foes in creative ways and win over the bloodthirsty crowd. Endure physical and mental injuries to defeat fearsome bosses and survive the day.

featured.name: EarthX 2
featured.shortDescription: Build and run your own space company. Launch reusable rockets, complete missions, and run a satellite internet network. Manage your factories and fleet, supply colonies on the Moon and Mars, and work toward terraforming the Red Planet.

featured.name: Enshrouded
featured.shortDescription: Enshrouded is a solo and co-op survival action RPG where your freedom and creativity come first. Conquer the Shroud, a corrupting fog devouring the kingdom of Embervale: explore a handcrafted world full of secrets, forge your hero your way, and build anything, anywhere in a fully terraformable land.

featured.name: Dupery: A Game of Solo Deduction
featured.shortDescription: A solo deduction roguelite with over 175 roles, set in a noir city run by a criminal syndicate. Investigate everyone, make arrests and protect your reputation. Take down the syndicate and don’t get duped like the rest. Everyone is a suspect, trust no one. No friends required.

featured.name: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!
featured.shortDescription: Brick By Brick is a relaxing tidy-up game you can play solo or co-op with up to 5 players. Collect, sort, and place 18,490 bricks to rebuild a charming town. Unlock helpful abilities and watch scattered piles become finished buildings. One brick at a time!

featured.name: Disney/Pixar Toy Story: Retro Roundup!
featured.shortDescription: Step back into Andy’s room with Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and more classic characters in Toy Story: Retro Roundup! This five-game collection features four Toy Story titles and A Bug’s Life. All the games have been upgraded with quality-of-life improvements and behind-the-scenes content.

specials.name: Enshrouded
specials.shortDescription: Enshrouded is a solo and co-op survival action RPG where your freedom and creativity come first. Conquer the Shroud, a corrupting fog devouring the kingdom of Embervale: explore a handcrafted world full of secrets, forge your hero your way, and build anything, anywhere in a fully terraformable land.

specials.name: Scam With Your Friends
specials.shortDescription: Run a scam call center with your friends. Use increasingly ridiculous schemes to trick AI callers out of their life savings. Hit your daily quota, cause chaos around the office, and survive a brutal performance review from your rageaholic boss.

specials.name: 007 First Light
specials.shortDescription: Earn the Number. 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Follow James Bond as a young, resourceful and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training programme, and discover an origin story of the world’s most famous spy.

specials.name: over the hill
specials.shortDescription: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic 4x4 vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

specials.name: Chained Beasts
specials.shortDescription: Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelike. Fight chaotic battles chained to your friends. Use your chains or the arena to beat up foes in creative ways and win over the bloodthirsty crowd. Endure physical and mental injuries to defeat fearsome bosses and survive the day.

specials.name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
specials.shortDescription: On RuneScape's forgotten continent of Ashenfall, dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft in this co-operative survival adventure. Only by mastering survival and uncovering ancient secrets can you hope to face the ferocious Dragon Queen.

specials.name: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2
specials.shortDescription: Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine. Unleash deadly abilities and devastating weaponry to obliterate the relentless Tyranid swarms. Defend the Imperium in spectacular third-person action in solo or multiplayer modes.

topSellers.name: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4
topSellers.shortDescription: War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches an invasion that threatens to destabilize the world in Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4.

topSellers.name: Enshrouded
topSellers.shortDescription: Enshrouded is a solo and co-op survival action RPG where your freedom and creativity come first. Conquer the Shroud, a corrupting fog devouring the kingdom of Embervale: explore a handcrafted world full of secrets, forge your hero your way, and build anything, anywhere in a fully terraformable land.

topSellers.name: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™
topSellers.shortDescription: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ is a ​runs-based, ​high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim. With the Empire gone and the galaxy rebuilding, The Galactic League is created: an underground, unsanctioned circuit where syndicates bankroll chaos and champions are forged.

topSellers.name: Scam With Your Friends
topSellers.shortDescription: Run a scam call center with your friends. Use increasingly ridiculous schemes to trick AI callers out of their life savings. Hit your daily quota, cause chaos around the office, and survive a brutal performance review from your rageaholic boss.

topSellers.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
topSellers.shortDescription: Crimson Curse —Will Your Fate Bloom in Despair or Salvation Set 23 years after Castlevania Dracula's Curse - follow Rose Belmont's journey in an all new 2D Action-Exploration title from KONAMI, Evil Empire and Motion Twin.

topSellers.name: over the hill
topSellers.shortDescription: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic 4x4 vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

newReleases.name: Card City Nights Forever
newReleases.shortDescription: It's cards! It's a city! It's night! And this time it's forever! Card City Nights Forever is the third and final installment of the series, with the best core TCG gameplay yet, a whole new huge 3D adventure, and an online mode that will last forever!

newReleases.name: Sparky Rush: Purrils in Pawsville!
newReleases.shortDescription: Sparky Rush is a lost-media PSX platformer with elements of psychological horror, where its developer descends into complete sorrow and madness. Play as Sparky and discover all the morbid secrets left by its creator before his sudden disappearance.

newReleases.name: Dreadline Express
newReleases.shortDescription: Dreadline Express is a 1st-person, psychological horror metroidbrainia set aboard the last human train. Unravel mysteries of the enigmatic train, face strange passengers, and shape your path using a unique card-based mechanic that gives you full narrative control. This is no longer our world.

newReleases.name: Norvale Chronicle -Amethyst journey-
newReleases.shortDescription: An SRPG set on the Helia Continent, which has flourished through magic. Lead your allies to confront a conspiracy that originated from the war in Norvale, a region in the northeastern part of the continent!

newReleases.name: Dynastia FC
newReleases.shortDescription: Dynastia FC is an idle football incremental where you watch matches unfold from above. Manage your roster, upgrade your club, and squeeze every coin from your fans. Rise from a dirt-pitch underdog, conquer the multiverse, and build a football empire.

newReleases.name: Bone Idle
newReleases.shortDescription: Put the dead to work. Dig up bones, hire skeletons and watch your horde haul them across 18 floating graveyards. Beat guardians for lasting medals, then perform the Great Ritual and grow a 31-node tree that makes every run stronger. Your workers keep digging while you're away.

newReleases.name: Robot City: Delivery
newReleases.shortDescription: Take control of the world's most popular delivery robot! Race through the neon city, collect packages, use boosts and hearts, avoid bombs and obstacles, and unlock new levels. Can you deliver all the packages and become the best courier?

newReleases.name: M!RACLE home_page
newReleases.shortDescription: They were going to be social media millionaires! ...Five years later, they have only eighteen subscribers. Now Roo’s bedroom has been rebuilt, his friend is missing, and strangers laugh at everything he does! A choice-driven psychological horror visual novel about finally being watched.

newReleases.name: Subjected
newReleases.shortDescription: With the promise of fast, easy cash, you participate in a trial conducted by a mysterious pharmaceutical company. Your only task is to complete ten rounds of Hangman while receiving intermittent doses of their experimental drug. The company assures you the procedure is completely safe. Good luck.

newReleases.name: Catch the Octopus
newReleases.shortDescription: Catch the Octopus is an online multiplayer hide-and-seek game for 2 to 24 players. Transform into objects as an Octopus to fool the Seeker and escape, or become the Seeker and hunt down hidden Octopuses. Use unique abilities to stun, chase, and escape in unpredictable rounds with your friends!

newReleases.name: No exceptions
newReleases.shortDescription: 🌐 Language Independent “Rules are absolute. Break them, and you die. No Exceptions.” Escape a building from the 10th floor in this death game. Each floor has prohibited actions. Break a rule and it’s game over. Don’t run. Don’t stop. Don’t look. Learn the rules. Obey them. Escape alive.

newReleases.name: Duel Mahjong
newReleases.shortDescription: "Duel Mahjong" is an online multiplayer mahjong game incorporating item cards and superpowers. During matches, there are many ways to acquire item cards. By combining various card effects, you can devise winning strategies, enjoy a thrilling game of Mahjong with your friends!

newReleases.name: Maldhalla
newReleases.shortDescription: Just one more minute. Then another. Outlast endless hordes and a new boss every three minutes in this survival roguelite with 21 characters, 32 weapons, and relics triggered by weapon combos.

newReleases.name: Qiang Gu: Ghost Festival
newReleases.shortDescription: Defend the Ghost Festival tower in a free-to-play 2D pixel-art strategy RPG. Build your lineup, assign distinct classes, collect loot, trade for supplies, and survive waves of fantasy enemies in tactical auto-battles.

newReleases.name: Mercenaries Of Vector
newReleases.shortDescription: First-person mech combat where everything is made of lines of light. 100 missions in open battlefields, inside Battlecruisers and Dreadnoughts, and out in deep space! 10 Mega Mech bosses and a salvage economy that pays for every piece of hardware you rip from your dying opponents.

comingSoon.name: Online: 404
comingSoon.shortDescription: An open-world survival simulator where even seasoned veterans of the genre will have to rethink their typical survival approach and how they interact with the world around them. Play solo or with friends, follow the story or simply explore — just don’t forget your most important gadget.

comingSoon.name: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4
comingSoon.shortDescription: War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches an invasion that threatens to destabilize the world in Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4.

comingSoon.name: Escape from Playtime
comingSoon.shortDescription: An online 1-8 player co-op horror experience where you and your friends are trapped in an abandoned toy factory. A mysterious voice commands you for an unknown purpose as you explore shifting halls, scavenge for tools, and fight for survival against creatures that lurk in the dark.

comingSoon.name: Phantom Blade Zero
comingSoon.shortDescription: S-GAME presents Phantom Blade Zero, a fusion of classic Wuxia storytelling and exhilarating action powered by Unreal Engine 5. You play as Soul, a warrior with only sixty-six days left to live. Fend off assassins, unravel world-ending conspiracies, and defend your values with your life.

comingSoon.name: Probably Stolen - Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim
comingSoon.shortDescription: Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator set in a dystopian space station. Craft, trade, and smuggle goods of questionable origin, navigate faction loyalties, and stop rampant AI by killing those it controls. Earn enough to buy out your shop before rising rent forces your hand.

comingSoon.name: Beyond These Stars
comingSoon.shortDescription: Build a city on the back of a Space Whale and learn to coexist as you journey through the stars. Manage intricate supply chains and the needs of your people as you build outposts, meet aliens, and uncover the mysteries of the universe.

comingSoon.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
comingSoon.shortDescription: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

comingSoon.name: Tenebris Somnia
comingSoon.shortDescription: Tenebris Somnia is a 2D retro survival horror adventure game with live action cutscenes created by an award winning film crew from Argentina. Unveil the depths of a disturbing story by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures. ...What if they aren't just nightmares?

comingSoon.name: Nomad Drive
comingSoon.shortDescription: Repair your rundown RV and hit the road solo or in 1–4 player co-op through a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, customize your RV, and survive as long as you can.

comingSoon.name: We Were Here Tomorrow
comingSoon.shortDescription: You and your partner awaken inside a mysterious Norček facility with little recollection of how you got there. Communicate, cooperate, and unravel the secrets in this asymmetrical co-op adventure. Only together will you decide the fate of Tomorrow…

comingSoon.name: ATMOSFAR
comingSoon.shortDescription: ATMOSFAR is a sky-high odyssey set on an alien planet of floating islands explored by flying crafts and a mobile airbase as you uncover the fate of your collapsed colony.

comingSoon.name: THE DEAD WE KNEW: Open World Survival
comingSoon.shortDescription: Explore a dangerous open world, loot abandoned places, build your shelter, produce food, and manage your resources. Survive alone or in co-op against zombies, hostile humans, and the growing dangers that come with the fog.

games.name: Balatro
games.shortDescription: The poker roguelike. Balatro is a hypnotically satisfying deckbuilder where you play illegal poker hands, discover game-changing jokers, and trigger adrenaline-pumping, outrageous combos.

games.name: Baldur's Gate 3
games.shortDescription: Baldur’s Gate 3 is a story-rich, party-based RPG set in the universe of Dungeons & Dragons, where your choices shape a tale of fellowship and betrayal, survival and sacrifice, and the lure of absolute power.

games.name: Black Myth: Wukong
games.shortDescription: Black Myth: Wukong is an action RPG rooted in Chinese mythology. You shall set out as the Destined One to venture into the challenges and marvels ahead, to uncover the obscured truth beneath the veil of a glorious legend from the past.

games.name: Celeste
games.shortDescription: Help Madeline survive her inner demons on her journey to the top of Celeste Mountain, in this super-tight platformer from the creators of TowerFall. Brave hundreds of hand-crafted challenges, uncover devious secrets, and piece together the mystery of the mountain.

games.name: Counter-Strike 2
games.shortDescription: For over two decades, Counter-Strike has offered an elite competitive experience, one shaped by millions of players from across the globe. And now the next chapter in the CS story is about to begin. This is Counter-Strike 2.

games.name: Cult of the Lamb
games.shortDescription: Start your own cult in a land of false prophets, venturing out into diverse and mysterious regions to build a loyal community of woodland Followers and spread your Word to become the one true cult.

games.name: Cyberpunk 2077
games.shortDescription: Cyberpunk 2077 is an open-world, action-adventure RPG set in the dark future of Night City — a dangerous megalopolis obsessed with power, glamor, and ceaseless body modification.

games.name: DAVE THE DIVER
games.shortDescription: DAVE THE DIVER is a casual, singleplayer adventure RPG featuring deep-sea exploration and fishing during the day and sushi restaurant management at night. Join Dave and his quirky friends as they seek to uncover the secrets of the mysterious Blue Hole.

games.name: Deep Rock Galactic

highlighted.name: If Only I Got Paid For This...
That's Not How You Play This Game

games.shortDescription: Deep Rock Galactic is a 1-4 player co-op FPS featuring dwarven space miners, procedurally-generated destructible environments, and endless hordes of alien monsters. Explore cave systems, mine for minerals, and work together to survive!

games.name: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut

highlighted.name: The Opener Of The Eighth Seal
Literally The Sorriest Cop On Earth
Baddest Hustler In The Neoliberal Hood

games.shortDescription: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut is a groundbreaking role playing game. You’re a detective with a unique skill system at your disposal and a whole city to carve your path across. Interrogate unforgettable characters, crack murders or take bribes. Become a hero or an absolute disaster of a human being.

games.name: Dota 2
games.shortDescription: Every day, millions of players worldwide enter battle as one of over a hundred Dota heroes. And no matter if it's their 10th hour of play or 1,000th, there's always something new to discover. With regular updates that ensure a constant evolution of gameplay, features, and heroes, Dota 2 has taken on a life of its own.

games.name: ELDEN RING
games.shortDescription: THE CRITICALLY ACCLAIMED FANTASY ACTION RPG. Rise, Tarnished, and be guided by grace to brandish the power of the Elden Ring and become an Elden Lord in the Lands Between.

games.name: Factorio
games.shortDescription: Factorio is a game about building and creating automated factories to produce items of increasing complexity, within an infinite 2D world. Use your imagination to design your factory, combine simple elements into ingenious structures, and finally protect it from the creatures who don't really like you.

games.name: Hades
games.shortDescription: Defy the god of the dead as you hack and slash out of the Underworld in this rogue-like dungeon crawler from the creators of Bastion, Transistor, and Pyre.

games.name: Hades II
games.shortDescription: Battle beyond the Underworld using dark sorcery to take on the Titan of Time in this bewitching sequel to the award-winning rogue-like dungeon crawler.

games.name: Half-Life 2
games.shortDescription: Reawakened from stasis in the occupied metropolis of City 17, Gordon Freeman is joined by Alyx Vance as he leads a desperate human resistance. Experience the landmark first-person shooter packed with immersive world-building, boundary-pushing physics, and exhilarating combat.

games.name: Half-Life: Alyx
games.shortDescription: Half-Life: Alyx is Valve’s VR return to the Half-Life series. It’s the story of an impossible fight against a vicious alien race known as the Combine, set between the events of Half-Life and Half-Life 2. Playing as Alyx Vance, you are humanity’s only chance for survival.

games.name: HELLDIVERS™ 2

highlighted.name: Hold my primary, I'm going in!
Samples are a diver's best friend
It's the only way to be sure...

games.shortDescription: The Galaxy’s Last Line of Offence. Enlist in the Helldivers and join the fight for freedom across a hostile galaxy in a fast, frantic, and ferocious third-person shooter.

games.name: Hollow Knight
games.shortDescription: Forge your own path in Hollow Knight! An epic action adventure through a vast ruined kingdom of insects and heroes. Explore twisting caverns, battle tainted creatures and befriend bizarre bugs, all in a classic, hand-drawn 2D style.

games.name: Hollow Knight: Silksong
games.shortDescription: Discover a vast, haunted kingdom in Hollow Knight: Silksong! Explore, fight and survive as you ascend to the peak of a land ruled by silk and song.

games.name: Inscryption
games.shortDescription: Inscryption is an inky black card-based odyssey that blends the deckbuilding roguelike, escape-room style puzzles, and psychological horror into a blood-laced smoothie. Darker still are the secrets inscrybed upon the cards...

games.name: Outer Wilds

highlighted.name: From the Hearth to the Moon

games.shortDescription: Named Game of the Year 2019 by Giant Bomb, Polygon, Eurogamer, and The Guardian, Outer Wilds is a critically-acclaimed and award-winning open world mystery about a solar system trapped in an endless time loop.

games.name: Portal 2
games.shortDescription: The "Perpetual Testing Initiative" has been expanded to allow you to design co-op puzzles for you and your friends!

games.name: Red Dead Redemption 2
games.shortDescription: Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde Gang are outlaws on the run. With federal agents and bounty hunters massing on their heels, the gang must rob, steal, and fight their way across the rugged heartland in order to survive.

games.name: Risk of Rain 2
games.shortDescription: Escape a chaotic alien planet by fighting through hordes of frenzied monsters – with your friends, or on your own. Combine loot in surprising ways and master each character until you become the havoc you feared upon your first crash landing.

games.name: Satisfactory
games.shortDescription: Satisfactory is a first-person open-world factory building game with a dash of exploration and combat. Play alone or with friends, explore an alien planet, create multi-story factories, and enter conveyor belt heaven!

games.name: Sekiro™: Shadows Die Twice - GOTY Edition
games.shortDescription: Game of the Year - The Game Awards 2019 Best Action Game of 2019 - IGN Carve your own clever path to vengeance in the award winning adventure from developer FromSoftware, creators of Bloodborne and the Dark Souls series. Take Revenge. Restore Your Honor. Kill Ingeniously.

games.name: Slay the Spire
games.shortDescription: We fused card games and roguelikes together to make the best single player deckbuilder we could. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics of immense power, and Slay the Spire!

games.name: Stardew Valley
games.shortDescription: You've inherited your grandfather's old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life. Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home?

games.name: Subnautica

highlighted.name: Fourteen Thousand Leagues Under the Sea
Seaside Living with an Ocean View

games.shortDescription: Descend into the depths of an alien underwater world filled with wonder and peril. Craft equipment, pilot submarines and out-smart wildlife to explore lush coral reefs, volcanoes, cave systems, and more - all while trying to survive.

games.name: Team Fortress 2
games.shortDescription: Nine distinct classes provide a broad range of tactical abilities and personalities. Constantly updated with new game modes, maps, equipment and, most importantly, hats!

games.name: Terraria
games.shortDescription: Dig, fight, explore, build! Nothing is impossible in this action-packed adventure game. Four Pack also available!

games.name: Valheim
games.shortDescription: A collaborative exploration and survival game for 1-10 players, set in a procedurally generated afterlife inspired by Viking culture. Battle, build, and conquer your way to a saga worthy of Odin’s patronage!

games.name: Vampire Survivors
games.shortDescription: Mow down thousands of night creatures and survive until dawn! Vampire Survivors is a gothic horror casual game with rogue-lite elements, where your choices can allow you to quickly snowball against the hundreds of monsters that get thrown at you. Be the bullet hell!

games.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered
games.shortDescription: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered modernizes the acclaimed role-playing game with a range of upgrades and enhancements. Become monster slayer for hire Geralt of Rivia and journey across a dark fantasy open world in an epic quest to find your adopted daughter Ciri.

review.body: Great ideas and gorgeous art, but the late game drags. Wait for a sale.
Gets better every hour. Push through the first act and it never lets go.
Great ideas and gorgeous art, but the late game drags. Wait for a sale.
Bought it on sale, would have happily paid double. Instant classic.

news.author: Miitchimus
